__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus-compatible data source with Asterisk res_prometheus and node_exporter metrics

title: Asterisk / FreePBX overview
description: Asterisk / FreePBX health: calls, trunks, endpoints, optional queue / voice-quality / CDR statistics, host and logs.

panels.title: Asterisk
panels.description: Scrape of res_prometheus (Asterisk's /metrics). DOWN = Asterisk or its HTTP server is not answering.

panels.title: Host
panels.description: node_exporter. No value at all = the host or the agent is gone.

panels.title: Active channels
panels.description: A call usually uses two or more channels.

panels.title: Asterisk uptime
panels.description: Orange for 15 minutes after a restart.

panels.title: Calls processed per minute
panels.description: From the asterisk_calls_sum counter: every call Asterisk handled.

panels.title: Call outcomes (optional, CDR-based, calls that ended in the last 5 minutes)
Outbound answer rate
panels.description: Busy and no-answer count as not answered, so 40-60% can be normal for outbound.

panels.title: Calls per minute by direction and result
Outbound answer rate per trunk
panels.description: Per outbound attempt on each trunk. One trunk dropping while others work points at the carrier.

panels.title: Service level
panels.description: Answered within the service-level target (e.g. 20 s) / answered.

panels.title: Voice quality (optional, RTP of the calls up now)
Worst MOS now
panels.description: Estimated MOS (1-5) from loss, jitter and round-trip time. Above 4 is good, below 3.6 is noticeable.

targets.expr: (sum(asterisk_rtp_mos_avg{pbx=~"$pbx"} * on (pbx, trunk) asterisk_rtp_streams{pbx=~"$pbx"}) / sum(asterisk_rtp_streams{pbx=~"$pbx"} and on (pbx, trunk) asterisk_rtp_mos_avg{pbx=~"$pbx"})) or on() vector(NaN)

panels.title: Free space per filesystem
panels.description: Call recordings and logs fill PBX disks: alert well before 0.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Outbound drawn below zero. RTP is roughly 80-100 kbit/s per call leg with G.711.

panels.title: Mounts
panels.description: 'stat error' = the mount did not answer (stale NFS, hung bucket mount).
